Container.Name: Pastey
Container.Overview: A lightweight, self-hosted paste platform (Pastebin alternative) with language detection and on-disk encryption. This fork exists because upstream Cesura/pastey has had no release since 2022, and the previous community image (arcscloud/pastey) was removed from Docker Hub. This build removes TensorFlow for a much smaller image, adds a default paste expiry and an expiry picker, supports IPv6 whitelist ranges, and defaults to dark mode.

Config.Name: PASTEY_RESTRICT_PASTING
Config.Description: Enable/disable restricting of pasting to whitelisted users.

Config.Name: PASTEY_RESTRICT_RAW_PASTING
Config.Description: Enable/disable restricting of pasting via /raw to whitelisted users.

Config.Name: PASTEY_RATE_LIMIT
Config.Description: Rate limit for pasting, for non-whitelisted users.

Config.Name: PASTEY_RECENT_PASTES
Config.Description: Number of recent pastes to show on the home page.

Config.Name: PASTEY_BEHIND_PROXY
Config.Description: Inform Pastey if it is behind a reverse proxy (nginx, etc.). If this is the case, it will rely on HTTP headers X-Real-IP or X-Forwarded-For. NOTE: Make sure your proxy config sets these values.

Config.Name: PASTEY_USE_WHITELIST
Config.Description: Enable/disable whitelisting for admin tasks (view recent, delete, config).

Config.Name: PASTEY_WHITELIST_CIDR
Config.Description: List of whitelisted IP addresses or networks (in CIDR format).

Config.Name: PASTEY_DEFAULT_THEME
Config.Description: Default theme for new visitors. Choose Dark or Light.

Config.Name: PASTEY_DEFAULT_PASTE_EXPIRY
Config.Description: Default paste expiry in hours. Pastes may choose a different expiry using the expiry picker.

Config.Name: PASTEY_GUESS_THRESHOLD
Config.Description: Threshold for automatic language detection guesses. If a result is below this value, it is treated as Plaintext.
